title: Seat model
description: A reservable position in the engine (PROTOCOL.md §4.7): the unit of extensibility. standing = occupied by an entity; vacant = reserved, not yet filled. Unknown fields MUST be preserved and ignored by consumers.

bind_policy.description: Vacant-seat semantics: auto = fill on matching node registration; manual = fill only via seat.bind.

expect.description: Expected profile a filling node must match. capabilities = all required; tags = any-match; metadata = key/value equality. Unknown fields ignored.

node_id.description: Occupier node id; null for vacant seats.
